_comment: Curated overlay applied by tools/AstroPlanner.DataBuilder on top of OpenNGC. commonNames: English common names of the Messier objects that have one (from AstroPlanner v1; generic descriptions such as 'Globular cluster' are left out, OpenNGC names are kept as alternates). messierOverrides: Messier id -> OpenNGC name of the object that carries it, where OpenNGC differs from the usual convention (OpenNGC lists M102 as a duplicate of M101; the app follows the common identification with NGC 5866, as AstroPlanner v1 did).
